assets.produced_prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: photorealistic dorsal insect body cutout for a mobile game with separately animated procedural legs. Create ONE realistic adult reddish-brown cockroach central BODY ONLY, photographed strictly straight down from overhead orthographic view. Head points exactly to top of image, abdomen points down. Anatomical oval elongated abdomen with two closed leathery chestnut wing covers, fine longitudinal veins and central seam, rounded dark warm brown pronotum shield and small tucked-under head. Natural fine chitin texture, subtle satin highlights from soft overhead light, realistic dark amber edges. Entire body sharply focused and bilaterally symmetrical. Important: NO legs, NO antennae, NO side appendages, NO cast shadow, NO background, NO surface, NO text. These parts will be added and animated separately by code. Body centered vertically, fills about 75% image height, body is about 2.2 times taller than wide. Genuine transparent RGBA background, clean alpha silhouette.
assets.description: Realistic overhead cockroach chitin body. Six jointed procedural legs and sweeping antennae are drawn and animated in App.jsx.
